title: Dubsea Sport Promotes Geno Smith's Starbucks Drink to Benefit Boys & Girls Clubs
htmlContent:
Dubsea Sport, a Seattle-based media company, reports that Seattle Seahawks quarterback Geno Smith to promote his go-to drink at Starbucks. The drink, which is called the "Geno Smith Special," is a Caramel Macchiato with Oat Milk.

Dubsea Sport posted pictures of the drink on social media with the caption, "If you haven't had a chance to order Geno Smith's go-to drink at your local @starbucks yet, next Friday (Oct. 27th) is your last chance! Proceeds go the Boys and Girl Clubs."

Smith is a big supporter of the Boys & Girls Clubs, and he is excited to partner with Dubsea Sport to raise money for the organization.

Smith shared, "Hey 12, come out and show your Seahawks spirit each Friday in October by visiting your local Washington Starbucks and order my favorite drink, a Caramel Macchiato with Oat Milk, and Starbucks will donate $1.27 to the Boys and Girls Club of King County. Together, we can make the future for the youth in our community."

The Geno Smith Special will be available at all Starbucks locations in the United States on October 27th. Proceeds from the sale of the drink will go to the Boys & Girls Clubs.

The Boys & Girls Clubs of America is a non-profit organization that provides after-school and summer programs for kids and teens. The organization has over 4,000 clubs across the country, and it serves over 4 million kids each year.

The Boys & Girls Clubs offer a variety of programs, including sports, arts and crafts, and academic assistance. The organization also provides a safe and supportive environment for kids to go after school and during the summer.

The Geno Smith Special is a great way to support the Boys & Girls Clubs and to get a delicious drink at the same time. If you're a fan of the Seahawks or Geno Smith, be sure to order the Geno Smith Special at Starbucks next Frida

There are a few ways that people can get involved in supporting the Boys & Girls Clubs:

  • Donate to the organization. The Boys & Girls Clubs rely on donations to fund their programs. You can donate online or by mail.
  • Volunteer your time. The Boys & Girls Clubs need volunteers to help with a variety of tasks, such as coaching sports, teaching arts and crafts, and helping with homework.
  • Become a member of the Boys & Girls Clubs. Members support the organization financially and help to raise awareness of its programs.
